author: Robert G.
body: Excellent chair! Comfy and efficient.

author: K P.
body: This office chair is one of the best ones I've come across. It provides great back support and allows me to sit for hours at a time without issue.

author: Jonny
body: This chair has one of the most comfortable lumbar supports I've encountered, and I've owned several similar chairs over the years and have used many Herman Miller chairs at work over the years. This chair also has some good features in terms of adjustable armrests, seat bottom depth, etc., so you can really tailor your seating position to find comfort. That having been said, the seat bottom cushion itself made my bottom numb in about 30 minutes and the armrests are a little too easy to reposition which becomes annoying when you want to adjust your seating position by leaning on them for leverage as they slide out of position. This frankly is not materially different from my experience with a Herman Miller chair, so when you consider the price point of this one, you're getting a comparable chair for a fraction of the price, which makes it definitely something to consider. I've paired mine with a memory foam seat cushion and it's doing quite well for me.

author: Joke_3
body: Putting together this futuristic-looking office chair was fairly straightforward, with clear instructions and various adjustment options for comfort. The lumbar support is commendable, but the price seems steep.

author: Chris
body: I??ve spent a lot of time in office chairs during my 30+ year career.  So I would consider myself an expert at sitting and know the difference between quality and crap.  Let me be clear the S100 is a quality product.  Assembly took me about 45 minutes using a clutched drill/driver, this included unpackaging but not disposal.  The parts came well laid out and labeled making assembly pretty easy.  Things I like:  Multiple adjustment options, you get normal adjustment and movement features as well as a few extras that set this chair apart from your garden variety sub $200 chair.  The armrests have a ton of adjustment features that I have only experienced with a few chairs that I have sat in (typically in an executive board room).  They can be moved vertically, rotated in the horizontal plan and moved laterally front to back, for you Trekkies this is the captain Kirk style battle stations or Full Alert position.  While lacking a headrest the whole back of the chair above the comfy lumbar support can move up and down where you need it (making a headrest unnecessary in my opinion).  I also like that the seat base can move forward and backward, making for a very comfortable seat if you are watching a training video, in a long meeting or taking a power nap during your lunch break.  The recline feature is similar to other higher end chairs I have sat in, it allows you to either lock it in place or lets you rock in place (for those fidgeters out there).  Even though the recline lacks a tensioner I thought the tension was just right.  Like most office chairs the seat will rotate on its chrome base and move around on standard office chair casters.  As far as comfort goes, the mesh is a heavy rubber coated style of fabric that seems durable and has an appropriate amount of give.  Lumbar support is awesome, probably the best I??ve experienced, the dual pads are spring loaded and conform to your body.  The chrome base jazzes everything up and makes this chair look really good.  I can definitely see this in an executive board room or other power broker setting.  The only things I would improve upon would be an extendable foot rest and roller blade style casters, other than that this thing is top notch and worth the premium.  Definite thumbs up from this office chair guru, go get some.

author: James
body: This is definitely a quality chair suitable for anyone spending a lot of time sitting in front of a computer screen, whether for work or gaming. Some assembly is required, which takes about 30-45 minutes, depending on your proficiency. Once assembled, it looks impressive and offers good support, which is crucial for those sitting for long periods. Whether the somewhat high price is justified is up to individual judgment.

author: J.A
body: Upon laying eyes on this office chair, I immediately fell for both its style and the claimed ergonomic features. Since I was in the market for a replacement for my tired old office chair, I decided to give this one a shot to see if it lived up to its promising specs.

author: James
body: Chair is very well designed and fits modern interiors very nicely Highly Recommend

author: Y@d!
body:
The chair assembled similar to most office chairs and feels quite sturdy.  I would say that is typical of a mid-range mesh style office chair.  It is comparable to other office chairs of that style that I have used, but didn't have as much adjustment as I thought it would for things like lumbar support.  It barely goes low enough for me to sit in (5' 1" tall), but it is workable.

If you don't like having the arm rests in place sometimes, you have to choose to either install them or leave them off -- they do not fold out of the way.  They do adjust front to back, in and out, and up and down though.  The back adjusts up and down as well, but there is no head rest.  The lumbar support seems comfortable but is not adjustable.

Overall, this is a decent adjustable chair but quite pricey for the feature set.

author: J. P.
body:
The Sihoo Ergonomic Office Chair is a great chair. It is head and shoulders above your standard desk chair, including most of the ergo ones, and is far closer in quality to an Aeron or Steelcase than a warehouse store chair. It also looks really cool - the design is both futuristic and unique.

Out of the box, you have everything you need to assemble it in a single blister pack (photo 1), so all you need is some space and good eyes - the instructions are in tiny print.  Assembly is simple, and once put together, the chair is very solid and quite heavy, though easy to move on the 5 casters.  I particularly like that most of the adjustments don??t require any buttons - you adjust the arms or back and they just stay (you can reset by moving them to the end of their range of movement, which lets you return them to their original positions).

Ergonomically, I??m impressed overall with how adjustable it is - the back can raise and lower, the arms move up, down, in, out, forward and back, and the seat itself is height and depth adjustable.  All of the mechanisms are rock solid, so you feel secure and don??t need to worry about anything moving out of place.

In the ??so close?? category, though, there are a couple of choices that puzzle me.  First, the angle of the seat is not adjustable - though you can slide it forward and back, you can??t fine tune the angle for your legs, either as a whole or along the front edge.  With so many other adjustments that are typical on high end ergo chairs, this absence is notable.  The lumbar support is also unique - it will either work for you, or it won??t.  It consists of two mesh panels that are attached to the rear frame of the chair by springs.  It??s very clever, and surprisingly comfortable, but there is no way to adjust the lumbar panels vertically, so if they don??t hit your back in a good spot, you??re out of luck.

author: The W.
body:
Assembly:
The chair comes flat-packed with clear labels and decent instructions. It's quite heavy (25kg), so be ready for that when moving it. Assembly is manageable alone or with an extra hand and takes about an hour, especially if you take breaks and double-check everything. The high-quality, sturdy parts give confidence in its durability.

Adjustments:
Figuring out the tilting and locking mechanism might take some trial and error initially. The dynamic lumbar support is a standout feature, offering snug support that reduces fatigue. The adjustable armrests are appreciated, but some might find them lacking in options.

Fit and Comfort:
Ideal for my size (160cm, 55kg), but consider your own height and build when buying. Still evaluating the value for money, but quality and durability seem promising so far.

Conclusion:
The Sihoo Doro S100 impresses with its innovative features and focus on ergonomics. The dual dynamic lumbar support and independent backrest offer exceptional comfort and potential relief from back pain. While it's pricier than some alternatives, the quality, adjustability, and health benefits make it a compelling choice for those prioritizing comfort and back health. If you're in the market for a premium ergonomic chair, the Sihoo Doro S100 is worth considering, though be mindful of the higher price point and weigh it against your budget and needs.

author: Henry
body: The SIHOO Ergonomic Office Chair is a standout choice for home office setups. Its dual dynamic lumbar support system ensures optimal back comfort by adapting to my movements. With a 5-level adjustable backrest and 4D coordinated armrests, it offers customizable comfort to suit individual preferences. The recline angle feature enhances relaxation during breaks, promoting a healthier sitting posture. However, the assembly process is a bit time-consuming. Overall, it's a highly recommended option for those seeking ergonomic support and comfort during long hours of work.

author: Victor
body: This chair proved a bit challenging to assemble, taking around 2 hours to complete. Nonetheless, it offers great value, providing comfort, an attractive color, and being lightweight. It's significantly improved my workspace, though it's a tad short for me at 6'2".

author: lynn
body:
The SIHOO Doro S100 Ergonomic Office Chair has truly transformed my workspace experience, offering unparalleled comfort and support during long hours at the desk.

From the moment I sat down, I could feel the difference in quality. The chair's ergonomic design contours to the natural shape of my body, providing optimal lumbar support and promoting healthy posture. The adjustable headrest and armrests further enhance comfort, allowing me to customize the chair to suit my specific needs.

One of the standout features of the Doro S100 is its breathable mesh backrest, which helps to keep me cool and comfortable, even during extended periods of use. This feature is particularly beneficial during warmer months or in environments where air circulation may be limited.

The chair's smooth and silent rolling casters make it easy to maneuver around my workspace, while the sturdy construction ensures stability and durability for years to come. Whether I'm leaning back for a quick break or leaning forward to focus on a task, the chair remains stable and supportive at all times.

Additionally, the recline function provides a range of motion to accommodate various sitting positions, allowing me to find the perfect balance between comfort and productivity. The tilt tension adjustment feature allows me to control the resistance of the chair's recline, providing a personalized sitting experience.

As someone who spends the majority of my day seated at a desk, investing in a high-quality office chair like the SIHOO Doro S100 has been a game-changer. Its ergonomic design, adjustable features, and superior comfort have significantly improved my overall well-being and productivity. If you're in the market for a new office chair, I highly recommend giving the Doro S100 a try.

author: TechRadar
body: This review is for the SIHOO Ergonomic Office Chair, Adjustable Seat Depth, Adjustable Backrest Home Office Chair, Big and Tall Computer Chair (Light Black). It's an amazing, very comfortable chair that requires assembly. It's fairly heavy and may need two people to assemble. The instructions are clear, and all necessary tools are provided. The chair offers various adjustable options and provides excellent back support. Overall, I would recommend it for its great quality.

author: Harumi
body:
The chair arrives well-protected, with each element individually shielded. The assembly instructions are clear, with diagrams, and the screws are well-organized. I assembled it alone in a short time. The provided key and spare screws are a nice touch.

It's quite comfortable for me, with a thick and sufficiently wide seat. While the seat is firm, it does relax a bit with use.

author: Tacha
body: I ordered this SIHOO Ergonomic Office Chair because I have to work a lot at my desk and suffer from lower back pain. With my current chair, every time I get up, I have to walk hunched over for a while because my back hurts so much. So, it was definitely time to try out an ergonomic chair. The good news is that I have now tested this chair for 3 days and my back doesn??t hurt when I stand up. That??s a first! The problem though now is that I am 6.1 and on the curvier side of sizes. I wear a 2xl in women??s clothing. This chair is advertised for people who are big and tall, just like my last chair. However, while my last chair gives me plenty of room in the seat in both directions, this Sihoo chair is simply too small. Even when I fully extend the seat forward, I still have over a third of my legs unsupported. The hard plastic on the sides cuts into my thighs and it??s really uncomfortable. As the pain in my legs is not as bad as the pain in my back, I will continue to use this chair over my other one; however, I feel this chair should not be marketing towards the big and tall because it??s simply not big enough. All the pieces feel solid and are reasonably easy to put together. Once assembled, this chair is very heavy. Instructions were ok, but they were printed so small I had to use my phone as a magnifier. I also don??t like that the armrests keep moving around.  I wish you could just choose a setting to lock them into. This is without a doubt a wonderful chair for people with standard sizes. It they could just make the seat larger, it would make it even better.

author: G??raldine F.
body: This ergonomic office chair is very comfortable, especially with the two adjustable lumbar supports, providing ideal comfort for a desk position. It's adjustable in terms of backrest height and armrests. However, this comfort has its limits, as it lacks the ability to recline and, most importantly, a true headrest. It's not a gaming chair. The finish is good, and the white color adds to its pleasant design. The chair is quite heavy, which gives a sense of durability. It's also very easy to assemble (around 30 minutes). However, the proposed price is too high for this item. The support and wheels could have been of much better quality.

author: Sosofou
body: The gaming chair arrived well-packaged and took some time to assemble. It's robust and comfortable, with ample adjustments available. The lumbar support is spot-on, and I haven't experienced any discomfort during long gaming sessions.

author: Scubasteveb
body:
I work from home and have been on the hunt for a new chair and decided to give this one a try! The support it has is great and the adjustability of each aspect of the chair is also nice for customization depending on a persons height. However, the downside of the chair is the seat itself is a bit uncomfy. I personally was not a fan of the rigid and firm seat. It started to hurt after about an hour, so I decided to switch back to my old desk for that sole reason. Overall, I think this chair is a great option for someone who is looking for a more firm ergonomic chair because the support it has is amazing.

Also, the instructions are a bit confusing but overall pretty easy to build once you interpret the instructions!

author: Baz
body:
Assembly was a breeze with the included instruction manual, though I found a helpful assembly video on YouTube for the Sihoo S100C model. I managed to assemble it solo in just half an hour, using my bed to assist with connecting the seat section to the back. The manufacturing quality is superb, utilizing excellent materials. Having owned around 15 computer chairs with a budget of up to ??300, I'd wholeheartedly recommend the SIHOO S100C chair if it falls under that price range.

The ergonomic design and elegant style impressed me, offering full adjustability from seat height to depth. The adjustable armrests move up, down, inward, and outward. The lumbar support cushions with adjustable springs adapt to your posture, and the headrest/back is also adjustable. Reclining up to 135?? degrees offers relaxation after work, with easy adjustment via the height-adjustable lever.

Whether for remote work or daily office use, this chair is a top choice in its price range, offering comfort and adjustability suitable for extended periods of sitting. Highly satisfied and highly recommended.

author: Gabsou
body: In general, I have mixed feelings about using this 'ergonomic chair.' The lumbar support, back support, and armrests are good and very comfortable. But the seat itself is strangely firm and creates many uncomfortable pressure points. The seat's design also feels like it curves downward, reducing seating space.

author: Rnt M.
body: This office chair by Sihoo comes unassembled, which was a surprise considering the price. However, the assembly instructions are clear, and all the necessary tools are included. I particularly liked the design of the Allen key provided. Assembly took me about half an hour. Once assembled, the chair looks great and feels comfortable, although it might not be suitable for larger individuals. Overall, it's a good investment for those who spend long hours at their desks.

author: David
body: This is the fanciest chair I have ever owned.  It is such an upgrade from my last chair. I love how the back rest adjusts up and down as well as the arm rests.  It's super comfortable and has a great back support and recline.  It was a pain to put together to be honest, but well worth it in the end. I love it!

author: R??mi F.
body: Assembling this ergonomic office chair was a breeze, thanks to the provided tools and clear instructions. Each component, made of sturdy metal, exudes quality and durability. The adjustable seat depth and backrest allowed me to customize my position for optimal comfort. With its sleek design in light black, this chair seamlessly fits into my workspace. I can easily spend 4 to 5 hours without feeling any discomfort. Those who prefer a slightly firm seat will be pleased. Easy assembly and quality materials make this office chair an ideal choice for a comfortable and productive experience.

author: RAW1987
body: Assembly is quick and easy, with clear instructions and labeled parts. The chair is very comfortable, with elasticated fabric that molds to your body. The lower back support is comfortable and moves with you, unlike other chairs. The upper back provides excellent posture support, and the slide feature on the seat is helpful. Adjusting the arms is easy and provides unmatched comfort. Overall, this chair is perfect for gamers or office workers who spend hours seated, providing excellent airflow and support.

author: Quanisha
body: I order this chair to replace my other chair in my office at home .assembly manual was a lot of help not that hard to put together everything was detail down to the screws .the chair is very sturdy and easy to move around and swivel the material is very heavy duty and soft to the touch the headrest is adjustable  and the back support is great

author: kathy
body:
Short story: My husbands??s neck pain that had been growing, has disappeared, and he has totally abandoned his old cushy flaking fake leather abomination, in favor of the SIHOO Doro S100 Ergonomic Office Chair. Yay, because that old chair was disgusting and my husband is resistant to change.  Boo, I don??t get to use the chair much, and boy was that assembly a challenge!!!

Soooo many pieces.  I kid you not. After every few assembly instructions, I got to go backwards and re-assemble sooooo many pieces twice. And then at the end, after all was done,  when I was trying to figure out why the chair bottom wouldn't slide back and forth, I realized I had put the chair bottom on backwards.  Yes ladies, gentlemen, and respected others, this assembly is not idiot proof. Fortunately, with some creative supports, I was able remove the chair bottom screws and rotate the bottom 180 without having to take anything else apart.  Furthermore, while a t-handled allen wrench is kindly included, I am sure there would have been overly dramatic words to say, had I not a drill and the appropriate 3/16 hex bit. Anyhow, I ultimately got it done and then retightened anything that felt janky.

The seat slides back and forth with the top lever.  The back also leans back and forth in recline positions when you unlock (pull out) the bottom lever.  You can lock it in a fixed recline at 3 different positions (as opposed to any point along the recline spectrum.) You can leave the recline open, but I see no way to tension the open leaning feature.  The back can be raised for taller folks or lowered for shorter people.

The arm rests go up and down, backward and forward, and angle inward and outward. They are super easy to move,?? almost a slithery propensity.  Some will like the flexibility.  For some that might not feel as supportive.  For others it will be irritating.  For us, there was an acclimation period, that turned into appreciation.

AT 5??5??I like both arms and seat at their lowest setting. So if you're really short, you may be out of luck.

The swivel is great. The lumbar support is awesome. Ventilation is good.  The arms are supportive with a dense covering.

Tip on install,?? cut the pack of screws up into steps and open as you need them rather than flipping the entire pack over each time you need to figure out what to break into next. There are lots if extra pieces, that will want to fall out if you don't do this.  Also, this will help you keep pieces straight if you have to redo assembly steps like I did.

author: Geo
body: The SIHOO Doro S100 Ergonomic Office Chair really impressed me. It's from a reputable brand and the assembly instructions are straightforward. The parts are high-quality, and once assembled, the chair looks sleek and feels sturdy. But the real magic happens when you sit in it. Compared to my old chair, it's like sitting on a cloud. The back support is fantastic, whether you're lounging or working at your desk. Despite the high price, it's worth every penny."

author: OldGamer
body: This office chair from Sihoo arrives flat-packed and requires assembly, which is understandable given the price. The instructions are reasonably clear, and all the pieces are well-organized. Assembly is straightforward, and the included tools are convenient. The chair looks great once assembled, and it's comfortable for me. However, it might not be suitable for larger individuals. The adjustable features are appreciated, but the arms aren't as adjustable as expected.

author: Neta D.
body:
This office chair is great!! It is so beyond comfortable! I love how easily it glides around.

I sit in it for many hours without getting any backaches or having my legs ache.

Great purchase!!

author: crazy l.
body: I'm really impressed with this office chair in many ways. Assembly was easy and took just half an hour alone with the provided tool. The components were all well-labeled, and the instructions were easy to understand. There are so many ways to adjust it; it's hard not to find a comfortable position. The seat, arms, and backrest are all adjustable, and the lumbar supports feel like a hug when you sit. The mesh seat is lightweight and very comfortable. I couldn't find any faults with the comfort or ergonomics of this chair; I could sit in it for hours without discomfort. Very impressed."

author: Mr G.
body: This office chair is very unique, with its white color and elegant textured covering. The lumbar support, divided into two vertical parts mounted on large springs, is excellent. The components are well-packed, and assembly is straightforward. The chair offers various adjustments, though it's more suitable for average to tall individuals. The seat is slightly firm and doesn't tilt backward, which may not be comfortable for everyone.

author: Mojo
body: After 3 moves and countless hours sitting in my office chair, that was  just an off the shelf brand, nothing special, I finally decided to get a new one. After looking at quite a few and getting over my sticker shock. I went with sihoo, priced right, with enough support to get the job done. Overall I??m enjoying this style chair. A big improvement from my old one, plenty of support, with a high back head rest. Oh yea. ??????mojo

author: Clara
body: I work from home two days out of the week and three days out of the office. I needed a new chair at work so was able to get this beautiful and comfortable chair. First of all , this chair was easy to assemble. It has so many great features. The back can adjust to height. The seat moves forward if needed. You can also adjust the seat up and down for a more comfortable position. The back also has lumbar support for someone like me that suffers from back pain, this support is key. The wheels glide through effortlessly. Last the armrests, theses are adjustable to height as well. But also move inward or outward to whatever position feels comfortable. I only wish it had a locking mechanism so it would stay in the desired position. But overall this is an amazing comfortable chair and would definitely recommend.

author: David L.
body: nice chair and generaly comfortable but the armrest do not lock in place , too bad

author: Brent W.
body: I am 6'3'' and about 325lbs and love this chair! Very comfortable and fully adjustable. I spend the work day in my chair and was suffering from lower back pain but in this new chair I feel so much better! Highly recommend.

author: letmepicyou
body:
I tried this out for a little bit and found the seat to be a bit on the firm side.  Some folks like that, and if you do, you'll like this out of the box.  I found that my rear end needed a bit more cushion.  I have a memory foam chair cushion for desk chairs that I tried out with it and it's PERFECT.  Much more comfy.

I have to say, the big draw for me was the overall look.  When I look at it, I think about that episode of Star Trek: TNG where Barklay got super-smart briefly and built some crazy laser-chair in the holodeck and he's sitting in it and laser beams are zapping him in the head...this chair is like, far-out futuristic looking, and that's what I think of when I look at it.  It's great.  I'm also kind of liking the white...it's so much different than "every other desk chair".

If you're a crazy-dedicated gamer, you might want to put your surround sound speakers on the back of the chair firing through the mesh.  Just a suggestion.  I'm always trying to find a place for my surround sound computer speakers, anyway.

It is a bit pricey, but it is made well, and it's RIDICULOUSLY cool looking.  The seat IS a bit stiff, and if you're partial to chair cushions already like I am, you'll probably find one to be a good fit here.

author: Breanne
body: Easy to put together and looks great. It is so comfortable as well. It feels well made and like it will last a while. It can hold a good bit of weight as well.

author: CC
body: Excellent product , as described, comfortable ! Exactly what I was looking for .

author: Leo
body: Very comfortable, truly great, very nice gift.

author: Bluelarksong
body:
The chair was originally $300 cheaper when I selected it (it was $499)!
I chose classic black, thinking the mesh material would be less likely to catch cat hair than my current chair ?C and I was right (we have 3 cats at home).
Assembly wasn't too difficult, just a few hiccups, and it only took 30 minutes.
While there's definitely a noticeable increase in comfort, it doesn't quite meet the total ergonomics I expected from an $800 chair.
There aren't enough customization options to justify the price, and considering the investment, it needs to last a few years. At $499, I would have given it 5 stars, but at $800, maybe only 4 or 3.
Overall, I'm undecided. It's not that the product isn't quality or comfortable, but at nearly $800, I expected more.
It's a purchase to ponder, and ultimately, it's up to you!

author: Betty
body: I like the style of this gaming chair and the elastic lumbar support function, but its price is too expensive, at least twice as expensive as similar products. This gaming swivel chair is very heavy, and its comfort level is not ideal. It is recommended not to consider It If the weigh more than 160 pounds. However, because the seat has a mesh design, It does make me feel cool and breathable.

author: Slava
body: I work from home for straight twelve hours and for last three years I have been looking for something which can help me with my back pain and also keep me comfortable and I ended up buying this chair which did not disappoint me. The first part was assembly which was a piece of cake for me although I am not a handy man type of person but I assembled it in less than twenty minutes by following the given instructions. It has high back which gives a perfect lumbar support and its material is breathable which keeps me comfortable. It has moveable armrests which I can adjust according to my needs. My son is 5 feet 2 inches and he also enjoys it as he can adjust the height of the chair while doing his work on computer.

author: Sviatoslav M.
body: Unbelievably good chair that is both easy to assemble and nice to sit in. Not does it look good but also it is very comfortable chair with lots of controls and it does not make you sweat while you are in it. Love it.

author: L. K.
body: First off, this chair was delivered to us without the manual, which made assembly challenging. It's quite bulky and heavy. It appears sturdy. In terms of comfort, I like the lumbar support and the ability to adjust the seat depth. It's nice to be able to rest my head. The backrest is adjustable in height. However, the armrest pivots too easily, which is a bit disappointing. I was used to having an option to recline the chair, and unfortunately, that option is not available on this chair. Nonetheless, if you're looking for good support, it does its job well. I find it too expensive. At this price point, I would have preferred non-plastic wheels.

author: D*****L
body: What an amazing chair. I am a remote worker that is in my chair all day. So having all these adjustments was a must have for me to get that perfect fit. I do wish the seat was a little softer as the chair as a whole is on the firmer side. So I had to add a pad to the seat for it to be comfortable for me. Assembly was quick and painless and comes with everything you need to get it together. Super adjustable and ergonomic design this chair is amazing. Besides the firm seat this is one of the best chairs I have had from durability, adjustability, and comfort.

author: T. W.
body: Update since my review after more use of the product and giving a much better score. From my usage of the chair, I noticed that the chair would correct your sitting posture and made you sit up properly with the chair seat and align with the dual lumber. I had been using the chair, and the back pain improved noticeably within a week. I will add 1 more star to the review based on thisAnother thing is that my chair had issue with armrest (the screw hole not align), and Sihoo reached out to help out. I was surprised about it since they are proactively helping their customer. I gave my feedback on the chair and they took corrective action on it. This is a much better customer experience than I expected. I did not expect Sihoo would reached out and wanted to solve the problem. A post purchase experience is great, especially willing to help and correct the armrest issue. This is another star being added.Over 98% reviews are from vine free product and not trust worthy. The back support is great. The dual lumber is excellent design and others should follow.Minor complains from others but not real issue in my opinion.No headrest. It's not a real issue for me.A lot of people complained about arm rest moving too easily. It's not really an issue and maybe annoying at times.The one complain for me is the waterfall seat design . The angle was too steep and forced your body to lean forward. It's not very comfortable and made the seat area smaller than it should. However, it enforces you to sit up properlyBack support is excellent and I wish gen 2 will fix the water fall seat design and it will be great.

author: A1
body: Nice chair, material is alittle rough but the chair is very comfortable and seems well made.

author: A Discerning I.
body: This chair is ergonomic and, with my seat cushion, quite comfortable. The arms flip up making it easy to get in and out (especially if you have a small office space like me). It boasts support all over from the hips up. It's quite adjustable to; headrest, lumbar and height. This chair could have me sitting for hours.

author: Clochette
body: I work from home two days out of the week and three days out of the office. I needed a new chair at work so was able to get this beautiful and comfortable chair. First of all , this chair was easy to assemble. It has so many great features. The back can adjust to height. The seat moves forward if needed. You can also adjust the seat up and down for a more comfortable position.

author: Baz
body: I am very impressed with the ergonomic design and elegant style it brings to my home. This is one of the those products that I can write a book on it but I like to keep this review short and concise. It is fully adjustable from seat height to seat depth according to your taste and physics.

author: Henry
body: The SIHOO Ergonomic Office Chair is a standout choice for home office setups. Its dual dynamic lumbar support system ensures optimal back comfort by adapting to my movements.

author: Amir
body: First off the customer service is very helpful. The chair arrived late, so they gave me a kind gesture due to this which was very kind of Sihooo.I have seen reviews where people are saying they are slipping off the base of the chair, I have not experienced this myself, unless the mateiral has changed since then, but I have no feeling of sliding off the base.The depth of the base I agree could have been deeper, even with the base fully extended forwards I do feel like there could be some more depth, I am 5ft10.5.The armrests are great in terms of adjustment, however I do feel like when reclining although its nice to see the arm rests follow the reclining of the chair, it would be better to have them fixed as sometimes I do like to work in a reclined position.The back supports that have springs are AMAZING... I honestly thought this was a bit of a gimmick when seeing other chairs adopting the same support system, but it is very very supportive, we have Herman Miller Aeron chairs too and they do not have the same level of lumbar support this chair has.The adjustable upper back is brilliant too.The build quality is phenomenal, most pieces are metal, which is nice or they have been given an outer metal skin, but overall the quality is great.The mechanism to have the chair go up and down is a bit of a reach though and often I end up pressing the seat base extension lever.Also, not so clear in the description, but this chair can be reclined and locked at about 2 certain angles, so that is very helpful.There is also no tensioner beneath the base of the seat, having this could be beneficial, but at this price range and other features and quality you are getting it is understandable that is was left out.If i had the budget or if Sihoo did there more expensive office chairs in the 350-450 range I would go for that hoping it would have even more features to make it more comfortable.Who knows Sihoo may be very kind and send me one to review :D

author: Eamen L.
body: The Sihoo ergonomic chair is definitely a great choice if you're looking for a chair that's suitable for both office work and long hours of gaming. This chair is designed specifically for prolonged sitting, offering excellent lumbar support to ensure proper posture and reduce pressure on your lower back. Additionally, its 3D adjustable armrests can be flexibly adjusted to meet individual needs, providing ultimate comfort whether you're working or playing. Highly recommended for friends who need to sit for extended periods at the office or home, this chair can bring you an unprecedented level of comfort.Excellent Lumbar Support: Designed for prolonged sitting, this chair provides outstanding lumbar support to help alleviate lower back pressure and maintain proper posture, preventing issues associated with long-term sitting.3D Armrests: The armrests can be adjusted in multiple directions (up and down, forward and backward and rotating) to meet different sitting postures and usage needs, offering maximum comfort for both work and gaming.Suitable for Long-term Use: Whether you're working long hours in the office or gaming at home, this chair provides an extreme level of comfort.Adjustable Height: In addition to the adjustable armrests, this chair typically features adjustable height, allowing you to set it according to your height and desk level to ensure a comfortable sitting position.Breathable Material: Many ergonomic chairs use breathable mesh fabric, ensuring you stay cool even when sitting for long periods, enhancing overall comfort.Overall, the Sihoo ergonomic chair combines ergonomic design and multifunctional adjustments, making it a highly recommended office and gaming chair. If you need a chair that provides excellent support and comfort, this chair is definitely worth considering.

author: Barry F.
body: Chair was not what I thought it would be but customer service was great and handled our issues.

author: Andrija
body: I have ti say that this is the most comfortable chair that i have ever used. Im very very fascinated and i would recommend this model to anyone who needs an office chair and sits for long periods of time. The quality is also amazing and everything is made out of metal or hard plastic, so the chair wont break easily. What im also amazed by is the comfort of the hand rests, its made out of some hard sponge material but also very comfortable to lay your arms on. Overall amazing product!

author: Zie
body: Chair works well and the company is awesome. Great experience from both. Thank you! ??

author: Amazon C.
body: I'm using it for home-office and so far it has been a comfortable chair

author: Mr&Mrs L.
body: I had some issues with installation, but customer service immediately sent videos with instructions. They followed up the same day to ensure my issue was resolved. Chair is very comfortable with great lumbar support. Great value for the cost. Highly recommend it.

author: Clayton A.
body: For context I am 6'1 147 lbs and have had trouble finding chairs that give me proper back support as I am working at home most of the time. The dual cushion back support seems a little gimmicky but it wrap around my lumbar pretty nicely. Bugles recommend if you are on the fence.

author: Fei S.
body: It is very comfortable and adjustable, good for work from home ,install is very easy with detailed instructions.

author: Amazon C.
body: Overall, the chair is particularly good. The exception to this is the following: the chair back does not stay up high where I want it but slides down; instead of 3 positions for the chair, it really needs 4 positions; and, the arm rests easily slide around when I have my elbows on them (it can be irritating at times).

author: Amazon Shopper 7.
body: I bought this chair for my home office. The chair is very comfortable with adjustable height, seat depth and arm rests. This is the most comfortable chair I ever owned. In addition, it looks great. I wish I bought it sooner.

author: Kevin O.
body: I had low expectations at first but damn this chair is actually better than I thought.

author: Ernest
body: The installation process is straightforward, and the cushion and back materials are well done. The armrest and back are restored to position when you set it up to the max height, so you need some time to get used to changing the height appropriately. I found it a pretty exciting solution. The length of the armrest is pretty good, and my elbows feel great now :-)Overall, it's a good chair, and I'm glad that I bought it at a discount and paid 500$The cushion sliding has been fixed by removing some patches attached to the hand (see 3\\4 photo). Now it is working correctly and is better than I expected.

author: Amazon C.
body: Well, Herman Miller costs you 2k +, and of course that is better than this chair. But if you only want to pay around 500, this is the best compared to other options on Amazon. Most importantly, customer service is there for you. They did reply to my email and shipped the spare part. Thank you Cindy for addressing my concerns and shipping out the spare parts so fast. I mean not every Amazon seller ships replacement parts by DHL and they arrive in less than one week. Anyway, you pay what you get, and I am happy with it.

author: tj
body: The chair is excellent and functions as advertised. It took me some time to adjust to the lumbar support, but it ultimately helped me maintain proper posture and work for long hours at my desk.

author: Daniel
body: Confy, easy to assemble,  looks great, nice adjustment, perfect back support,  good quality

author: Joe
body: I bought this from the Sihoo website. I really like the lumbar support versus the traditional pillow like setup most chairs have. One thing that was odd at this price point is that there was no seat tilt option (just a slide option). My only complaint is that I have a long-ish spine and the arm rests do not quite come up enough to support my elbows, which puts strain on my shoulders. Some minor tweaks to the chair fix it, but I think more functionality (7-8 settings vs 6) on the armrest would really sell it.

author: Madeeha
body: It may be a desk chair but it works wonders for gamers as well. My boyfriend needed a new chair so we tried this out with little hope, however, once he sat in it (after putting it together quickly) he loved it. I think his favorite part is when he leans back and can lock it into the position so if he gets up its still in it.  I think its super swanky the arms move in several directions

author: Sambhu Prasad N.
body: I had bought one SIHOO Doro S100 Ergonomic chair - The built quality is very good, comfort is to level of any high end chairs in the market, modern design. I liked every bit of the chair.

author: Tony R.
body: .Very nice quality in the construction and materials. The chair is comfortable for my stature.The 4D arms claim is interesting, but by George, it works. Fixed arms can be annoying. The flip up arms on models are great - but this is quite an improvement.Just like adjusting the height and other aspects, the arms can be positioned for comfort. That feature adds a lot of value for me over the great overall quality.

author: FraggleRock
body: Putting it together was pretty easy.  Came with one broke part, which was the lever that lets you slide the seat back and forth.  superglue fixed it.  Anyway it's pretty comfy, and I like the style.  Looks cool too.  I'd say this however, the seat just seams a bit small for what it's trying to do.  Needs more length and maybe an inch more width.  You notice it when you lean back and you feel the back of the seat.  It's not that noticeable though.  Other than that, it's a nice chair.  Perhaps a bit overpriced.

author: scale m.
body: First the chair and box weigh almost 50 pounds! This is your first indication to the high quality you will find inside the box.Quality abounds. Not only is the chair and base very safely packed, all of the parts are wrapped to protect them and you also get all of the nuts, bolts and washers needed to assemble. As a bonus you will also receive a nice hex nut driver to install the bolts.The chair was very easy to assemble, but you will find it easier if you have a helper, due to the weight.Most important is that the chair is really comfortable! It is also very adjustable, in case multiple people use the chair, they can customize the sitting, lumbar and arms to their liking.Great product, highly recommended.

author: SFC
body: This is a pretty comfortable mesh style office chair. Solid metal base with smooth rolling caster. Simple assemble with clear instructions.

author: JAWs
body: This is a very heavy duty chair, just in the weight alone, you can feel the quality build. The chair is very easy to assemble, and give you pictures and instructions to go along with it. One minor point is the 5 mm T handle started slipping in the handle itself for tightening the bolts, and so I ended up using a separate Allen wrench to finish the assembly. Not that big a deal over all, just something to be aware of.As far as the chair itself, it has recline mode, height adjust mode, seat adjust in and out mode, arm height adjust modes, arms in and out mode, chair back up/down adjust mode, pivot mode, and rolling mode and everything seems like very good build quality. The arms are attached to really strong support structures. And the price at the time was a good price point too.The open mesh design is comfortable, and I am 6' 1 tall, and I like the high back setting. Impressive.

author: The H.
body: Firstly, This is a heavy chair. This weight contributes to the solid feel you get when sitting and rolling in it.The mesh remains tight after use, which continues to provide comfort and alittle spring to your adjustments.The chrome legs give it a more refined look over simple plastic black.The arm adjustments are becoming a standard feature, but I still am relieved to see them on new chairs.*5 stars!

author: William K. S.
body: So this chair arrived a couple of days ago and i've been using it in my home office for 9+ hours a day the past few days.If you read nothing else know that it's very comfortable and adjustable.Assembly:So the included instructions are very lacking so plan on using the online assembly instructions. That said everything was packaged well  and unwrapped easily. i used the box it came in as a stand to help assemble it and got no surprise issues. The only issue i had was figuring out which direction to attach the baseplate as neither the video or instruction specify. i did have to redo that once. I love the T-handle tool they provide for screws it makes the assembly simple.  Everything went together quickly and cleanly and it took about 1 hour to finish.Comfort:I'm 6'2 and 240lbs. The chair supports my shoulders easily though not my head. The lumbar support is really quite good. As a person with a bad back i'm impressed. I was able to though out the back support pillow i used in my old office chair. The armrest are very adjustable and after a bit of fiddling i found the perfect setup for my desk and really like this chair. The mesh back is cool and flexible. 5 Stars for comfort even for long period of sitting.

author: Kindle C.
body: I have reviewed many chairs. This one is a standout. At forty-six pounds it is one of the heaviest that I have encountered. The design definitely sets it apart from the run of the mill chair. I love the spring mounted, two part lumbar support. Few chairs offer forward and back adjustment of the seat. It does not have a headrest, but I did not miss a headrest as I put my feet on my desk and leaned back for a nap thinking that I might need a pillow, but the upper part of the chair held my head comfortably enough. I love this chair.

author: L
body: The Sihoo Doro S100 is a must have at the price of $200 if you're looking for a new chair, and have back, leg & butt pain from your old chair. The design is similar to the brand name model that has been on the market for 10+ years, my dad has that chair, so I can easily compare the two. This costs 1/5th of that chair though, which is pretty amazing you can get something similar now for a fraction of the price. The two are not completely the same though.The one main feature that sets it apart from the competitors is the lumbar support. It's pretty unique as it has one support for each side that moves with your movement. I often have to shift to the left or right, and it feels pretty nice, keeping that support while doing so.The arm rests move forward, up and down, and to the sides. The armrest movements are very similar to my other chair, which everyone and their grandma has, but that chair actually locks those positions in place, which this does not. So it can easily slide back to a position you didn't want it in.Installation took longer than expected which was about 1 hour by myself. I got hung up on the part that slides into the bottom of the seat, as the instructions were not the clearest.When it comes to the final part it wants you to put the seat into the hydraulic wheels, but that felt nearly impossible to do. The seat once assembled is pretty heavy, and you cant see the hole. So what I did was put the seat upside down again, I used my bed and a box for the right height, then I held the wheel cap in place turned that upside down and put it in that way. Flipping it right side up adds extra weight now with the wheels, only reason I see they didn't want you to do it that way. This would be hard to assemble if you're a single female I am sure.The arm rest assembling is a bit odd too, you have to put the screw in from the bottom, while holding the arm rest in one hand, and a tool with the screw in the other.The main negative I have with the chair, is the two supports from your lumbar you can feel the hard plastic sometimes on your spine, which doesn't feel that good, its only in certain spots, when you slouch and are not sitting up right. You also feel this plastic base from the back rest itself when its fully extended(which happens when you turn it upside down to assemble it), thankfully you don't feel this if you drop the back rest all the way down, which I didn't think was possible, but the way the mechanism works for both the back rest and the arm rest extension, is you extend it to the max height then it will drop down.Overall I think this chair is a steal for this price, the pros outweigh the slight negatives.

author: Brentochan
body: Heavy (in a good way) and very well-built. The chrome base provides a little pop to the look if you're into that. Assembly is straightforward and simple.Lots of adjustments so finding a comfortable posture is pretty much assured. Rolls well and generally feels very solid.

author: Ron
body: This chair is fantastic. Easy to assemble and built durable and sturdy. Has some good adjustable functions and is the most comfortable office/gaming chair I've owned. Back support is a huge plus!  Great chair to invest in your office, gaming room, or wherever you like.

author: shy
body: The pillow and lumbar support will automatically adjust with the body posture, so you won't get tired after sitting for a long time. The seat cushion can be adjusted in height with one switch. Because the lumbar support is a kind of embracing feeling, the lumbar support will automatically support the body as it moves left and right. The backrest and pillow are designed as one piece, which makes it very comfortable to lie down. The mesh design is not afraid of heat in summer, but I am worried that the mesh will lose its original elasticity after long-term use. Be careful when cleaning it, otherwise it will get stuck.Installation is not simple, a bit time-consuming, and the casters are not smooth enough.

author: Michael H.
body: I have always liked the look of the plush leather chairs. That is until I sat in this one. I now use it everyday as my main office chair. I do not care it looks a bit meh. Its comfortable and my back, neck, hips, and shoulders love it!! It took a bit of assembly but nothing outrageous. Its heavy but moves well on its wheels. My advice, find one of these try it out, and then pull the trigger never looking back at the classic executive chair. Comfort is King here!

author: GRILLMASTER7
body: In 2008 I paid $400 for a used Herman Miller Aeron Chair size C. It wasn't all that comfy. The arms were a hassle to adjust. The back rest didn't move in height and the back support attachment was tearing and never stayed put.  This chair reminds me of the Aeron chair but this one's easy to adjust and more comfortable. The material used for the frame seems like the same used on the Aeron chair. The mesh on the seat, lower and upper back isn't as dense but seems sturdy. There's less tension in the lower and upper back then there is on the seat. The chair base has 2 controls. One for raising and lowering and one for tilt release/recline. The chair will recline more than 120 degrees I'm guessing and I've found 2 different positions I can lock the seat into a recline position. The seat will slide forward a little over an inch just have to lift on the tab. The upper back will raise 4 clicks for a total of 4 inches maybe. I'm 5'10 and I can easily rest my head back. No need for a separate head rest attachment. The lower back sections don't adjust. They rest on springs so there's a little give all around. The arms raise 6 clicks and stay put. The elbow pads slide forward and back easily about an inch. No locking mechanism there so it's easy to slide out of place. The eblow pads pivot out 1 click and pivot in 4 clicks. They lock in place but can easily be moved by accident. This chair took about 50 minutes to put together from opening the box.  It came with a handy allen wrench tool and the screws and washers were all grouped together. The instructions were clear and easy to follow. Size wise, this fits like an Aeron Size B chair. I hope the company can sell replacement mesh screens for the seat if it ever tears. Not sure if i'd sit on this for 8 hours a day. This chair is more for light duty. It's stylish, well made and comfortable. This is a great product and worth every penny of the $300 listed last I checked. I'd get this instead of a cheap vinyl chair from office depot that's gong to crack and peel off over time. I have 2 such chairs. And I'd get this over the newre Aeron chairs that are still going for $500 used today.

author: Off The Grid K.
body: I'm typically partial to a leather office chair mainly for the overall look and durability. Plus I'm a big fan of natural materials but when it comes to adjustability you really can't beat this chair.I'm 6'2 and roughly 200 lb and it adjusts to me like a glove. It can help you correct your posture, or it can allow you to sit comfortably. You can move your arms in, out, up or down and adjust your height and lumbar to your heart's content.They're a bit heavier than I expected but not nearly as heavy as my lower counterparts. The mesh is tight and firm and only time will tell about its longevity. I'm not sure what you do when the mesh starts to get loose or rips. For my leather chairs I just reupholster them but for this I don't know what you do.Regardless this is a great chair for the price and far higher tech when it comes to adjustability than my standard leather choices.Until We Meet Again-Off the Grid Ken

author: Jason
body: This chair was pretty easy to put together.  It it very very comfortable. While putting this together, I noticed how nice the build quality is.The arm rest and height adjustments works smoothly.  Overall, this looks like a high end type chair.I will update this review after using it for a while. This will give me time to test out the back support.I would recommend this.

author: DC
body: I have been looking at this SIHOO DORO S100 chair for a while now and I am so glad I ordered it!! I had heard good stuff about these chairs, but I was unsure how comfortable sitting on mesh would be. Would it be supportive yet comfortable to sit all day at my desk, answer...Yes!! This chair has many adjustable features, the height of the chair and headrest, adjustable armrest, but the adjustable depth of the seat is a game changer! Finally a chair that actually fits me.  I would buy this chair again and recommend it.

author: Matt C.
body: Easy to assemble. Come with everything you need and really clear easy instructions. The chair is a super comfortable full size chair. It reclines a lot and has really good support with the high back. Lots of adjustment points. The only thing I don't like is the arm rests swivel in and out really easily and it gets knocked out of place easily. Overall, it's a great chair.

author: Data G.
body: So the chair itself is SUPER comfortable. The back support is two independent side panels are positioned at an angle that completely avoids putting pressure directly against your spine. Assembly was straight forward and took about 15 minutes. The seat extender (able to slide out to support longer legs) is awesome.The one thing I immediately tried to do and realized is missing from the chair - there is no lean back tensioner. You can lock the seat to prevent leaning back but there is no way to adjust the fairly light pressure it takes to lean back. Not a deal breaker but it is the reason I am rating only 4 stars. Yeah yeah, perhaps I should have realized this before purchase but, well, this is my review so I can say whatever I want.Overall, not a bad chair for the price.

author: Frank M.
body: This chair works for me very well.  The best part for this chair is the 2-piece waist support.  That makes my back very comfortable.  The second good point is the recline feature.  You can choose to move free or set at a fixed position by pushing the lower handle inward.  The mesh structure fit my body perfectly, at the thighs, waist and the back.  The heights of both the backrest and the armrest can be raised.  It is fancy that when you raised to the highest level, they will go to the very bottom then start over again.  I like to set everything to the lowest level, so I can keep my head straight.  It is a pity that the seat can only set flat or move forward.  If let me wish, I would wish the seat also able to recline.The installation is not hard, but you need to have mechanics experiences.  The instruction is not easy to understand, especially the figures are too small to see the details.

author: THX1138
body: I needed a new office chair since my old one broke.  The recline function could no longer be locked, so it was always rocking back, no good.  That one cost 3 times what this one did, and it lasted just under 3 years of daily use.  I decided to try a less expensive chair, especially since a pricier one didn't last, I figured if this one lasts a year, it's the same per year cost to sit as my old one.The chair comes with some assembly required.  First, I will note that you should open the box carefully from the top and pull the contents out that way.  The instructions will have you use the box to hold the chair upside down while you install some parts to it, so don't destroy that box opening it.The assembly was straightforward enough, and took me about an hour.  All the tools you need are supplied (allen wrenches), so you won't need any of your own. For some reason it also came with a pair of thin children's gloves.  I assume it's to wear while assembling, but the gloves really are tiny. The only part I wasn't thrilled about on assembly was the fact that the chair legs come in pieces.  I would have preferred a solid unit, but then again, this is an inexpensive chair.  Once assembled, it seems sturdy enough.  The supplied wheels roll fine on low pile carpet, and I've had no issues with the gas strut.I've had the chance to use this chair now for a couple of weeks.  The dynamic lumbar support is surprisingly good.  It seems really flimsy and gimmicky at first, but when you sit and lean into it, it really does a pretty good job of conforming to your body and providing back support.The seat can be adjusted in and out, so you can fit it to your legs.  I am 6 feet tall, and have the chair out almost as far as it will go, and it's perfect for me.  The back can be set to freely rock, or locked in one of three positions: upright, all the way back (maybe a 60 degree angle), and one position in between.There is not an adjustable headrest, instead the whole back can be moved up and down (separate from the lumbar pads).  It seems OK, I was able to lift it to the highest position and be comfortable, but I think I prefer a separately adjustable head rest.The only thing I can say that is negative about this in terms of quality is the arms.  They are a little flimsy, and they move too easily.  I can bend the arms down and forward nearly two inches by using them to lift myself up or lower myself down.  The arm brackets themselves seem to be cast aluminum, so the part that is flexing under load must be the chair base.  This is disappointing, and I expect this might be the part of the chair that fails first.  Aside from that, the arms do adjust up and down, and forward and back, but not in and out.  They rotate from the back of the arm, so you can bring the ends of the arms in closer, just not the whole arm.  This is the biggest non ergonomic area of the chair I've found so far.Overall, this is a budget chair, and the quality and adjustability are commensurate with that fact.  If you need a mesh chair and are on a budget, this is a decent choice, just don't expect full ergonomic control.  You'll get quite a bit for the price, just not everything.

author: Dad's M.
body: Despite it's futuristic look, this chair is incredibly comfortable. The padding is intelligently placed and supportive. The back of the chair is very high and looks awkward at first.....until you realize it's the perfect height to rest your head when leaning backwards.I wish the instructions were a touch clearer, but all the nuts, screws, and bolts are individually packaged in the order as you need them so that's nice. Overall, no complaints and really happy about this purchase!

author: Saving w. S.
body: It did take a while to put together. As soon as I sat down, I felt instant relief on my back. It is comfortable and easy to adjust. The fabric makes it easy for your body to breathe. Definitely worth the investment for my office.

author: Ryan
body: I have used many basic chairs but switching to Sihoo was a refreshing upgrade. Packaging was solid, assembly was easy, and adjustable lumbar support is excellent.

author: Alex
body: This is a very comfortable office chair with excellent venting and pleasant cool upholstery material. Armrests are highly adjustable, very solid and comfortable. Backrest support is fine but I didn't quite appreciate those springs that make is a bit shaky experience of getting up and seeing chair keep wobbling. Overall this is an excellent chair for the money, simple to assembly and very well built.

author: jeff n.
body: Very comfortable chair. Easy to assemble. Seems to be really sturdy.

author: TamTam
body: This chair is nice and comfortable to sit in for 8 hours if needed. It was easy enough to assemble and the directions were clear.

author: The D. G.
body: This chair has completely transformed my home office. The lumbar support is fully adjustable and makes it easy to maintain good posture. The 4D armrests move in every direction, allowing for a highly customized setup. The design is modern, the seat and tilt functions are smooth, and the chair feels solid. A great choice for anyone working long hours.

author: NAA
body: This chair has been a huge upgrade for my home office. The lumbar support is excellent, and I love being able to fine-tune the armrests and seat height. It is sturdy and offers great comfort throughout the day. Very happy with this purchase.

author: human X.
body: I was impressed by the comfort of the seat cushion. The width and thickness of the bottom make it soft and hard, and it doesn't feel uncomfortable or digging. The width adjustment is very smooth, and it is easy to find the best position for your desk and height. For a detail-oriented person like me, the design is really thoughtful. The tilt adjustment of the backrest is a bit a bit. Although the adjustment range is sufficient, the installation support of the backrest is not so uniform at some extreme angles, which makes it feel a bit awkward. In addition, the time spent on this chair was amazing. The icons on the manual are not very clear. It is possible that I was a little confused and could only operate it intuitively. However, after installing it, all problems disappeared.

author: Natasha
body: This is the best desk chair ever. It is heavy duty and yet so comfortable. Super simple to put together and fits in my office space so well. This is the best desk chair ever. It is heavy duty and yet so comfortable. Super simple to put together and fits in my office space so well. I enjoy that. Is it the details and being adjustable to each person cannot be overlooked. Super great value

author: LVGoodguy
body: The SIHOO Doro S100 Ergonomic Office Chair is a standout product that delivers on all fronts. Its dual dynamic lumbar support is a game-changer, providing consistent support that adapts to my posture throughout the day. The upgraded seat cushion is firm yet comfortable, ensuring I can work for hours without any discomfort. The 4D armrests are highly adjustable, letting me find the perfect position whether I am typing, writing, or relaxing. The adjustable headrest is another excellent feature, giving great neck support during long meetings or gaming sessions. The mesh design keeps the chair breathable, and the white and grey color scheme gives it a sleek, modern look that fits perfectly in my home office. Overall, the Doro S100 strikes a perfect balance between style, comfort, and functionality. It is a worthy investment for anyone looking for a high-quality ergonomic chair. Highly recommended!

author: Alejandro G.
body: Sihoo knows their game. Really comfortable chair for home office. The lumbar support on this chair is fantastic as well as the breathable mesh. It's also tall enough for people up to 6.2 or so and provides great cushion. Ideal for long sittings too.

author: The C. N.
body: This is a great chair. It is heavier and larger than expected, but assembly was simple, parts were well protected, and the mesh seat and back are breathable. Excellent adjustable armrests and durable design. Highly recommended.

author: G
body: This installs easily and rolls evenly

author: Sarah
body: Will be returned. Build quality is appalling for the price point. I got the basic model. The leveler is broken, therefore I was not able to adjust the depth of chair as advertised. Lumbar support is decent although the second leveler was able to adjust how far it leans back as advertised. In addition, to the restock fee charged. This is ridiculous considering that it came broken!!Update: Customer service resolved my issue and reassured packaging  will be fixed for future customers.

author: Brian M. L.
body: This overbed table feels premium. The tilt function works smoothly, and the pneumatic lift adjusts the height effortlessly. The base is solid, and the materials feel high quality. Easy to assemble too.

author: Crash O.
body: Love that the chair is so configurable, the seat slides backwards and forwards, height (Of course) - seat back adjusts up and down, arms slide forwards and back, adjustable height for the arms, just wish you could lock the rotation and actually lock the arm height. It's on a vertical ratchet, 4 clicks upwards then it resets and can drop back to the bottom. That's just a personal preference though and doesn't detract from the overall review of the chair.

author: AC
body: I selected this for my son who was in need of a chair for his desk (mostly for playing games).  I had purchased a gaming chair for my other son that had a lot of issues, so I wanted something with a more simple design.  This chair was easy to assemble and really looks nice, quite modern.  My son has been using it for a month or so now and seems to be very happy with the comfort with no complaints (although his brother's gaming chair definitely has some cooler features).  The adjustments seem smooth and everything just works.  Overall a great office chair option but the price is a bit steep.

author: Tatiana C.
body: Assembly was easy and the chair feels solid. However, when I sat down to test it, it was not as comfortable as I expected. The spring-based lumbar supports push forward a bit too much, giving a sensation of being pushed. Still, I appreciate that each component is adjustable to suit individual preferences.

author: A Vine R.
body: This is an excellent office chair by SIHOO. My partner uses it and reports it's very comfortable. I want to share some notes I made while assembling this chair.* You need to have some upper body strength to lift and maneuver the chair portion onto the gas lift. Don't be too proud to ask someone for a hand.* Do NOT throw away the box! You need it for when you're attaching the seat and back to each other.* The instructions are packed inside the bag that holds the seat.* The instructions are in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, and Arabic.* There's a QR code in the instructions for a video showing assembly. Make sure you check the video's description for a link to the updated video.* Personally, I found it confusing when the printed instructions and the video demonstration both changed perspectives occasionally. Maybe you might, too.* This comes with white, cloth gloves, but they're on the small side.* The only tools you need would be something to get into the shipping box. I used scissors.* There are extra bolts and washers.* There are 2 sets of Washers J, but you use 4 at a time.* If you're looking for part P, the Decorative Cover, it's probably already on Base K.* The arm rest pieces come in a box, and if they're wrapped in different colored bubble wrap, it doesn't mean anything.* If you don't want your chair to have arms, feel free to omit them.* There are 5 black plastic pieces that have no part designation in the instructions. They go inside the silver legs and over the arms of the base (the starfish-looking black metal piece). These plastic pieces may be inside the legs or be loose or maybe be on the base. Make sure you don't throw them away!* The legs and the chair parts seem to lock in place on their own when you're assembling them onto the gas lift.* And lastly, the chair didn't smell bad fresh out of the box.I hope these notes help someone.Again, the chair itself is very comfortable, perfect for long sitting sessions. I think the lumbar support is a bit odd, but my partner likes it but says the chair reclines a bit too far.

author: Annej S.
body: This chair fits all sizes with great adjustability. The lumbar support adapts automatically and overall the chair is very comfortable.

author: BretteK
body: This chair is the stuff! It is so adjustable. The armrests rotate in, out, up, and down. The back is in two sections. The top section can raise up and down. The bottom also adjusts up and down AND forward and backward for varied depth. The lever that raises and lowers the bottom can also be pulled out to unlock the back to allow for reclining in the chair. I found the upright position to be extremely straight, so I really like the reclining back. My husband is 7 inches taller than me, so being able to increase the height of the back, depth of the seat, and height from the floor allows both of us to use the chair with some customizable adjustments. The materials are good quality. Even though it is made of mesh, they created a pillow feel at the neck and lumbar support that feels cushioned. My husband and I both LOVE this chair!

author: Customer
body: Right out of the box, this chair feels substantial and well-made. The assembly is relatively easy, but if you are a weaker person, it could be cumbersome. Once assembled, the chair rolls easily on hard surfaces and yes, this chair is heavy. I am 5 feet 9 inches tall and the chair is easily adjustable for me. I use this as my office chair in my small business. Granted, I do not sit for extended amounts of time, but when I do sit for decent periods, the chair is comfortable and I find that I do not have to adjust myself in the chair to get comfortable. There are many adjustment settings, one of which I sort of find annoying. The armrests adjust in height and swivel. The swivel adjustment does not lock in place and is easily swiveled without intention. All in all, I would give the chair a 4.5, but since I cannot and the chair deserves more than a 4, I am giving this chair a five-star review.

author: J. L.
body: The chair offers excellent value for the price. It has plenty of adjustability options. The only small issue is the armrests reset to the lowest point instead of locking with a lever, but that is not a big concern.

author: jacob k.
body: Hands down one of the most comfortable office chairs I've ever used. Love how the lumbar support contors to your back. 5/5 stars would buy again. Only complaint is the instructions are pretty lacking but it's rather straight forward to figure out on assembly.

author: Charles P.
body: Absolutely comfortable, good back support

author: Josue G.
body: At 6'1" and 240 pounds, I find this chair to be a perfect match for my adjustable-height desk. The only minor drawback is the frame being a bit too snug for me to sit cross-legged, but that is far from a dealbreaker.

author: Atlas
body: Excellent chair, very comfortable.

author: Carter
body: Really fast shipping came in perfect condition and just as described very comfortable chair

author: Jiwei
body: I bought the Sihoo S100 for its ergonomic design and am very happy. Lumbar support and seat cushioning are excellent and customer service was very helpful.

author: Lisa A.
body: This is a really comfortable office chair. Assembly was quick, and lumbar support is excellent. Armrests adjust smoothly and overall the chair is fantastic.

author: Ambers.Book.Cave
body: This chair was very easy to assemble. Ergonomically, it is great. Lumbar support and headrest are solid, and the armrests are adjustable. Comfortable for daily use.

author: Alberto
body:
What I like:
- it is comfortable and ergonomic. It definitely help me to stay in the correct position. I had to adjust to it, but I really like it. It helps me to leave my bad sitting habits.
- the sitting base is solid, large and comfortable and the curved profile assists in keeping a good and healthy posture.
- I love the spring lumbar supports. They hit on the right spot and with the right force (but it is not adjustable neither in heights nor in stiffness).
- the mesh is firm and elastic. I hope it lasts.

What I do NOT like:
- just three lockable positions: vertical/mid/reclined.
- free inclination movement stiffness not adjustable.
- I hate the free rotation of the arm rests. If I want to put some weight on them, they just rotate out of place and I slide out. A lock button is very much needed!!!
- the wheel base is assembled with independent spokes made of bent and soldered steel. Even my much cheaper chairs have a solid metal star base. I hope they do not loose up at the hub with time or, worse, begin to fail at the weld lines.
- the wheels do not rotate/slide as freely as I would expect. Maybe they will improve with time, but I am not impressed with them at all.
- the wheel hub is made of plastic.
- the back rest without a separate head rest is a 'hit or miss' for me. It is generally comfortable, but I miss the chance to support my neck/head even when looking straight (as in the office chair models).
reply:
Hi there,

Thank you for sharing such a detailed and well-considered review of the S100. We really appreciate the time you took to explain your experience from a long-term, posture-focused perspective.

The S100 is designed primarily for users who spend long hours at a desk and are looking for structured ergonomic guidance rather than soft, highly flexible seating. Features such as the firmer mesh, fixed-position spring lumbar support, and limited recline lock points are intentional design choices meant to encourage a stable, upright working posture and help correct unhealthy sitting habits over time. For this type of task-focused use, consistency and support are prioritized over frequent movement or lounge-style flexibility.

That said, we fully understand that preferences differ. For users who rely heavily on armrests for weight support, prefer more recline options, or want integrated head/neck support, a different model or chair style may be a better fit. Your feedback around armrest rotation, wheels, and base construction is valuable and helps other customers better understand whether the S100 matches their needs.

If you ever have concerns about performance over time or would like help exploring solutions or alternatives, our support team is always available at support_us@sihoo.com.

Thank you again for your honest insights, they help both us and future customers make better decisions.

Best regards,
Sihoo Team

author: EL
body: After using the Sihoo S100 for a while, I can confidently say it performs extremely well. Everything from the comfort to the overall support feels thoughtfully designed for daily work use.

author: christa d.
body:
Easy set up and comfort
Extremely comfortable chair. Well worth the money! Easy set up. Put together alone and only took about 45 mins. Love that I can lean back in the chair

author: isabel
body:
Good support for all parts of body
Very happy to purchase this chair. As a patient of cervical spondylosis, this chair supports my neck very well and provides just the right amount of support at the waist and elbows. After installing it and just testing it for a while, I ordered a second one for my husband.

author: marina
body: This chair is very comfortable and has a clean, modern design that fits perfectly in a home office. It looks professional without being bulky, and it feels just as good as it looks.

author: eveline
body: This is easily the most comfortable and supportive chair I have ever owned. I noticed a real improvement in my posture, and my back pain has significantly decreased. Sitting for long hours now feels much more natural and less tiring.

author: Mirko
body: The Sihoo S100 has completely changed how my workspace feels. The dynamic lumbar support actively supports my lower back, the adjustable armrests adapt easily to different tasks, and the breathable mesh keeps me cool during long work sessions. Whether sitting upright or reclining, the chair feels incredibly well balanced and supportive.

author: Rick W.
body:
Excellent Office Chair
I've been using this chair for the last few months and it's been very comfortable. My typical work day is sitting at an office desk for 8+ hours and I've had no issues with my back since purchasing this chair. I would highly recommend it, especially for larger persons.

author: Jennifer
body:
Great purchase
Love my new office chair! The ultra-soft 4D armrests and dynamic lumbar support make it incredibly comfortable. The adjustable backrest and swivel feature are perfect for long work hours. Great quality and sturdy construction. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a comfortable and supportive office chair. Assembly was a breeze. Instructions were very easy to follow.

author: Brian
body: Very comfy, does exactly what i need it to do, a chair to game and work in.

author: Mathis
